technical_complexity.rationale: Growing ultra-high-purity single-crystal diamond is hard materials engineering; substrates reach only about 30 mm x 30 mm and larger sizes are limited by equipment (Electronics For You).

defensibility.rationale: Process know-how and the CEO's diamond supply-chain access help, but well funded rivals grow larger wafers.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too early to say. Search results show Diamond Foundry growing a 200mm diamond and Frore showing a diamond heat spreader in late 2026, so larger players are active.

market_need_then: AI chip power density is rising and thermal throttling is a documented bottleneck; diamond conducts heat about five times better than copper (YC page, press).
